why: The behavioural probes replay DETERMINISTIC visitor audio into Chrome's fake capture device, so the whole real path runs (getUserMedia → AudioWorklet → VAD → WAV → Deepgram → /voice/turn → streamed TTS) with only the microphone fixed.
how_they_were_made: Deepgram TTS (aura voice), pt-BR, one sentence per clip, then padded with trailing silence so the fake device's loop restart does not bleed into the clip. Regenerate with `node make-clips.mjs --tts --clips=<dir>` if DEEPGRAM_API_KEY is set.

clips.text_pt: Olá Mara, o que está aberto na lista da casa hoje? / E o que já foi feito hoje na casa?
clips.note: Two questions separated by ~9 s of silence, so ONE mic tap yields two complete exchanges.

clips.text_pt: Olá Mara, o que está aberto na lista da casa hoje? / Espera, e o que já foi feito hoje?
clips.note: Second question starts while the first answer is still playing.

clips.text_pt: Olá Mara, o que está aberto na lista da casa hoje? (repeating)
clips.note: A long speech burst to play into a CLOSED device: nothing may be uploaded.
40 s of quiet: the ear stays open and says nothing.

clips.text_pt: E o que já foi feito na casa?
clips.note: A ~600 ms pause inside the sentence (shorter than the VAD's 1.2 s timer).

clips.text_pt: E o que já foi feito ... hoje na casa?
clips.note: A ~2 s pause inside the sentence: the VAD sends twice, the page must merge and answer ONCE.
